episodes.title: First Encounter
episodes.summary: Yu Ji-an is an actress with a lot of fans thanks to her pretty face, but she is not the kind of actress who acts well. And she feels she is losing her popularity to her rival, Han Yi-jin. So she is advised to get psychological counseling from a famous counselor, Cha Eun-hwan, to get a hint to improve her acting skills from her subconscious. But at their first meeting, an unexpected incident happens.

episodes.title: Ji An’s Downfall
episodes.summary: After Ji An feels panic at Eun Hwan's clinic, she experiences a weird phenomenon, where she can listen to a man's voice out of nowhere. Meanwhile, Ji An meets Moon Gyeong Sik, a famous movie director, and gets cast in his movie, which is a huge opportunity for her. However, the emergence of her bullying video makes her popularity plummet, ruining her bright future.

episodes.title: Attempt to Comeback
episodes.summary: After moving to the small house compared to her previous villa, she realises that Eun Hwan is living across the hall and meets his daughter, Ha Yul. Ji An struggles to make a comeback despite her collapsed reputation in the industry, and she gets a golden chance to audition. Meanwhile, Eun Hwan is frustrated by his guilt over his client's arrest, so he tries to meet the victim of the crime.

episodes.title: Proposal to Eun Hwan
episodes.summary: Finally, Ji An feels sure that Eun Hwan's emotions are transferred to her. She receives praise for her acting because she can finally understand other people's emotions, thanks to transference from Eun Hwan. Hence, she suggests that Eun Hwan be her manager and help her immerse herself in acting. Meanwhile, Eun Hwan's situation is getting worse because he rejects the therapist position at J.An Entertainment and has to close his clinic because of the disciplinary action from the Association. Will he accept Ji An's proposal?

episodes.title: New Manager
episodes.summary: After Eun Hwan accepts Ji An's proposal to be her manager, they start practising their collaboration for the acting so they don't make mistakes during the shoot. However, when the shooting starts, Ji An is flustered upon realising that the emotional transference no longer works, and she is fired from the show. Hence, Eun Hwan tries to cheer her up by enhancing her reputation, and they try to figure out why the emotional transference is not working.

episodes.title: Audition
episodes.summary: Ji An and Eun Hwan guess that the reason why the emotional transference is reversed is the earlier kiss. So they try to kiss every hour in different places. After the emotional transference is reversed again, Ji An passes on an audition and gets a role in Director Moon's film. Also, Eun Hwan tries to find Mi Jeong, who accused Ji An, and tries to find out the truth of the power abuse case from her.

episodes.title: Reveals the Truth
episodes.summary: After Ji An knows that the culprit in Ji An's bullying case might be Yi Jin, she rushes to Yi Jin's dressing room and slaps her on the cheek. CEO Kim tries to drag Ji An down one more time, insisting that their fight was Ji An's one-sided assault. But his plan is ruined by Eun Hwan's attack, and the truth behind Ji An's bullying accusation is revealed. After being rehabilitated, Eun Hwan leaves Ji An, and Ji An is flustered by his absence.

episodes.title: Disappearance
episodes.summary: Ji An's mom, who has always tried to control Ji An, returns and reconciles with her. But after her comeback, Ji An's ordinary life is ruined. She interferes with her career, requesting Director Moon to increase her screen time. Hence, Ji An's reputation collapses again, and even Yi Jin gets angry at Ji An, believing that Ji An is taking her opportunity again. She decides to disappear from the public, and Eun Hwan tries to find her, feeling anxious.
